tasks.label: Release: dry run
tasks.detail: Preview the next version and changed files. Does not change files or contact the remote.

tasks.label: Release: bump, tag (no push)
tasks.detail: Run pnpm checks, sync package/Tauri/Cargo versions, commit and create a local release tag.

tasks.label: Release: bump, tag and push (build release)
tasks.detail: Run checks, bump, commit and atomically push main + tag. GitHub Actions builds and verifies the release before publishing.

tasks.label: Build: local release
tasks.detail: Build the current version locally: Windows NSIS installer + portable ZIP, or macOS app + DMG. No bump, tag or push.

tasks.label: Check: release checks
tasks.detail: Test release tooling, translations, Rust, frontend build and desktop UI.

inputs.description: New version: patch, minor, major, or exact stable X.Y.Z (for example 0.1.4)
